ranges.text:
contents: read
    strategy:
      # Don't cancel the other OS builds if one fails — a red Windows build
      # shouldn't deprive you of the mac/linux artifacts.
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            artifact: linux
          - os: macos-latest
            artifact: mac
          # windows-latest now ships VS 2026. The locked electron-builder chain
          # uses node-gyp 9, which recognizes VS 2022 but not VS 2026; retain the
          # supported native compiler until that toolchain is upgraded together.
          - os: windows-2022
            artifact: windows
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:

case "$TAG" in *-*) PRERELEASE=(--prerelease) ;; esac

          cat > /tmp/release-notes.md <<'NOTES'
          自动打包构建 — 用于在其他电脑(尤其 Windows)安装测试。

          **安装包签名说明**:
          - Windows (.exe / nsis):SmartScreen 会拦,点「更多信息 → 仍要运行」。
          - macOS 未配置 Developer ID 签名密钥时,产物会使用固定 requirement 的 ad-hoc 签名。
          - 从旧 cdhash ad-hoc 版本升级到固定 requirement 版本时,需要下载 .dmg 手动覆盖安装一次;之后固定 requirement 版本之间可走应用内更新。
